description: An expander for Kitsune that adds a gain CV and an offset CV input to each of its four sections; it goes immediately to the right of the Kitsune it serves

inputs.text: Shifts that section's ATTEN. knob on the Kitsune; the voltage is divided by 5 and added to the knob, with the total held between -2 and +2, so the attenuator can be driven into an amplifier
Shifts that section's OFFSET knob on the Kitsune; the voltage is divided by 5 and added to the knob, with the total held between -10V and +10V

notes: The expander does nothing on its own: it has to be immediately to the right of a Kitsune, and the light at its top left comes on when the two are talking.
These inputs are read one voltage per channel, so a monophonic cable modulates channel 1 only and leaves the rest on the knob setting.
The light under each input shows the voltage there: its brightness follows the value, and its colour follows the polarity and whether the cable is monophonic or polyphonic.
